description: Pinned Node packages for Ironmate. PptxGenJS writes the slide package shell; ironlib.xlsx_ooxml.write_package writes xlsx values with the Python standard library. ExcelJS is the independent test oracle for xlsx, so it is a dev dependency. Ironmate owns the Open XML for both and does not auto-install these packages. Playwright drives the browser tests (tests/*_browser.cjs, studio_clipboard.cjs); the same version serves the Pages, clipboard and Marp lanes.
